newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foster's says buyback won't cut dividends.
newsitem.headline: Foster's says buyback won't cut dividends.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd on Thursday said its proposed A$625 million buyback of shares would not mean a reduction in dividends.
Foster's chairman John Ralph assured this to shareholders at a meeting called to approve the buyback of 254.5 million Foster's shares from Japan's Asahi Breweries Ltd.
The buyback would push Foster's gearing to about 70 percent from around 35 percent now, Ralph said.
He said dividends payments would not be affected.
"Your board considers the buyback will not reduce the rate of dividend paid per share by Foster's," Ralph said.
The shares represent a 13 percent stake in Foster's.
The buy-back, announced last month, is the centrepiece of major changes to Foster's share register.
Another major investor, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, has already sold most of its 36.5 percent stake to brokerages which placed the stock with institutional and retail investors.
